_comment: Terrain type ids as stored in the live map array (u8, flat, row-major,
Each cell is a BITFIELD: low 5 bits terrain, high 3 bits owner.
terrain = value & 31,  owner = value >> 5   (0 neutral, 1..4 players)
Confirmed against four owned bases reading 46, 78, 110 and 142 -- that is
14 + 32n -- and two HQs at 40 and 72 = 8 + 32n. It also explains why every
These ids share an index space with the movement-cost table columns in
aw1_movecost.json, which is what resolved the Mountain/River ambiguity the
movement costs alone could not (their costs are identical for every unit).
The array ADDRESS is session specific. Locate it with matchrow(); do not
